tagline: A freeway with a scenic byway's papers.
intro: The byway begins at the I-40 interchange and simply follows the US 70 freeway around the south side of Clayton to US 70 Business. It is one of only two freeways in North Carolina with scenic byway status. Long straightaways carry it over rolling hills and open pasture scattered with woodlots, with views well out over Johnston County farmland.
The road is young as such things go. Construction began in 2006 and it was finished in June 2008. The country is older. The surveyor John Lawson came down the Neuse into the Clayton area in 1701.

moments.title: Clayton
moments.text: The town the bypass skirts grew from about 16,000 people in 2010 to more than 26,000 in 2020, helped along by its highways, this one among them.

moments.title: Powhatan
moments.text: The freeway ends just east of Powhatan, a crossroads 302 feet above sea level, set halfway between Clayton and Wilson's Mills.
